exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Keep a straight line from head to heels. Lower under control and press back up.

exercises.name: Air Squat
exercises.instructions: Sit back and down, keep chest up, drive through heels.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Elbows under shoulders. Brace core and hold a straight line.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge at hips, pull the dumbbell to your ribs, control the lower.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Stay tall, drop the back knee down, keep front heel planted.
